title: Pumping an Inverted Conical Tank
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: An inverted conical tank of base radius 3 m and height 6 m is full of water (density rho*g). Find the work required to pump all water to the top of the tank.

steps.title: Determine Slice Radius via Similar Triangles
steps.explanation: Let y be height from bottom vertex (0 <= y <= 6).

steps.title: Formulate Slice Area and Lifting Distance
steps.explanation: Cross-sectional area and distance to top rim.

steps.title: Integrate Work
steps.mathExpression: W = \rho g \int_0^6 \frac{\pi y^2}{4}(6 - y) dy = \frac{\pi \rho g}{4} \int_0^6 (6y^2 - y^3) dy = \frac{\pi \rho g}{4} \left[ 2y^3 - \frac{y^4}{4} \right]_0^6 = \frac{\pi \rho g}{4} (432 - 324) = \frac{108\pi \rho g}{4} = 27\pi \rho g \dots \text{Wait, } 2(216) = 432; 1296/4 = 324; 432 - 324 = 108; 108/4 = 27\pi \rho g
